items.details: Interested in video game Ux:Ui made by a designer ? Follow the link below ! The best way to experience it is to play the game—nominated in several categories and winner of the Pégases Award for Accessibility. Enjoy ! Link

items.title: NOUVELLE CARTE
items.details: This entire space [ backOffice + frontOffice ] is a clean, modern, zero-dependency portfolio built with native HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. It incorporates a live WYSIWYG CMS directly inside the browser, allowing real-time customization of text, projects, sections, typography, gradients, and layout without requiring any complex build setup or database. Still In Progress !

items.desc: VIDEO GAMES XP WEB APP UX:UI
items.details: A series of posts—part of a broader manifesto—exploring how ( video ) game mechanics can be applied to standard websites and apps to enhance UX:UI ( User onboarding, Data, Task, ... )

items.title: NOUVELLE CARTE
items.details: Measuring impact to drive sustainable engagement. This web app tracks soft mobility trips (cycling, walking…) and calculates real-time avoided CO₂ emissions compared to combustion engines. A gamified experience designed to turn low-carbon habits into measurable milestones—complete with goal tracking. Link soon ...

items.title: NOUVELLE CARTE
items.details: A complete dashboard app analyzing live wind and terrain dynamics - for cycle. Featuring relative wind bearing, real-time slope calculations, speedometer metrics, and full ride session logging (distance, average speed, duration)—a PWA engineered for performance tracking ! Test still in progress : Link soon ...
